title: Donate your accent
description: Help The Pudding create an accent quiz

places.name: Minnesota
places.sentence: Let’s play in the snow today.

intro.dek: We're creating an accent quiz and we need your help to showcase the unique ways {demonym} pronounce words.

record.prompt: Record yourself reading the following sentence:
record.review: Listen back to make sure it sounds clear.
record.tooShort: That was too short. Try again and read the whole sentence.
record.micDenied: We need permission to use your microphone. Allow it in your browser settings, then try again.
record.micMissing: We couldn’t find a microphone. Plug one in or try another device.
record.micBusy: Your microphone is being used by another app. Close it and try again.
record.micError: We couldn’t access your microphone. Check your browser permissions and try again.
record.unsupported: Your browser can’t record audio. Try the latest Chrome, Safari, or Firefox.
record.inApp: Recording may not work in this app’s browser. If it doesn’t, open this page in Safari or Chrome.

email.label: If we want to follow up for a better recording, what email can we reach you at?
email.hint: We’ll only use this to contact you about your recording.

demographics.hed: Optional: tell us a bit about yourself
demographics.hint: This helps us make sure the quiz represents a range of voices.

race.label: Race or ethnicity (select all that apply)

consent.label: I agree that The Pudding may use my recording in an accent quiz.

submit.needsRecording: Record the sentence above to submit.
submit.needsConsent: Check the box above to submit.
submit.error: Something went wrong saving your recording. Please try again.

thanks.text: Your accent is on its way to us. Keep an eye out for the quiz.
